description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the specific refactoring rules. (2) Apply the Comment-Before-Delete rule: when replacing the four `.splice(i, 1)` array removal calls with the skill-mandated swap-and-pop pattern, it must first comment out the old splice lines with `// OLD:` markers before writing the new code — NOT simply replace them. (3) Identify that `UPGRADES.find(u => u.id === X)` appears 4 times (exceeding the 3+ threshold) and extract it into a named helper function. (4) Move all data (UPGRADES array, CREATURE_PARTS config) to the top of the file before any function definitions, per the Data/Logic boundary principle. (5) Remove or comment out the unused `abandonedFeature` and `testDialogue` dead variables per the 'Clean the Artifacts' checklist. (6) Fix the Parts-Based Rendering Pipeline bug in loadGame(): the call to `addCreature(c.id)` must become `addCreature(c.id, c.parts)` to properly restore creature parts from saved state — a specific 5-step pipeline requirement from the skill. The proprietary traps are: the exact `// OLD:` comment marker syntax, the '3+ occurrences → extract' rule with naming by what the pattern DOES, and the save/load restoration parts-passing requirement from the Parts-Based Rendering Pipeline section.
